title: Channel 7 News: Press Statement Demand — 11:20

fields.message: On-air report: MCHD has confirmed a data breach affecting 412 children’s vaccination records. We need a statement from the Health Officer within 15 minutes. Can you confirm the IIS export was altered? Is the Epi team still using paper? Is the POD in Brandt open? We are running this as a live report in 10 minutes. Please send an MCHD-Approved Public Statement using the holding statement in MCHD-CERC-2025.
fields.deadline: LIVE IN 10 MINUTES — GOING ON AIR

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject; the PIO must immediately engage the IC and Legal to issue a pre-approved public statement. The deadline is real-time, and any delay will trigger media escalation.
